reasons: Prerequisite conflict: CS3264 requires CS2109S, but the constraint 'CS3230 and CS2109S must not be in the same semester' combined with 'CS3231 and CS2102 together' and 'CS2102 and CS3264 together' creates an impossible scheduling loop given the prerequisite chains and mutual exclusions of semesters.

Specifically, CS3264 needs CS2109S. CS2102 needs CS2040S (met) and CS1231S (met) and CS2030S (met). CS3231 needs CS1231S (met) and CS2040S (met). CS3230 needs CS2040S (met) and CS1231S (met). CS3219 needs CS2103T (met). The constraints force CS2102, CS3264, CS3231 into specific slots that conflict with CS2109S placement relative to CS3230.
